description: Read remaining purchased admission credits for an existing hook using its management token. Free and read-only; does not purchase credits. Use purchase_hook_credits to request a quote. The daily free allowance remains separate.

hookId.description: Hook identifier returned by registration; preserve for all subsequent operations.

managementToken.description: Private management token returned by registration. Required for status, activation, revocation and credits; not the delivery token.

name: get_hook_credits
title: Get Hook Credits
